sourcePathConvention: Each source is relative to sourceRoot in the product workspace.
outputPathConvention: Each output is relative to this manifest's directory.
resampling: LANCZOS, proportional resize of the complete image

evidenceStatement.zh-Hans: 沿用最新商店宣传成品及实际应用组件画面，笔记、纪要、录音时长、重点和接收状态含合成示例。画面用于展示界面与功能，不构成识别准确率、模型质量、设备间传输或电池续航实测。
evidenceStatement.en: These promotional images reuse the latest store artwork and captured app components. Notes, summaries, durations, highlights and receipt states include synthetic examples. They demonstrate the interface and features and provide no measured recognition accuracy, model quality, device-transfer or battery-life results.
